name: Barcode
description: Shows a barcode for an ID you supply -- a parkrun athlete ID, a membership number, a transit pass. Code 128 by default, or a QR code per code where whatever scans it uses a camera. Holds up to six, cycled on the watch. The IDs come from your phone; the watch only draws them.

configFields.label: Code 1 ID
configFields.description: The number printed under your barcode, copied exactly. Case matters. This is the code the watch shows first.
configFields.validationMessage: Up to 16 plain characters, exactly as printed.

configFields.label: Code 1 name
configFields.description: What the watch calls this code, so you know which is which when you cycle through them. Optional.

configFields.label: Code 1 format
configFields.description: How to draw this code. Code128 is the ordinary barcode and works with every scanner. QRCode only works where a phone camera does the scanning -- a laser scanner cannot read a QR code at all.

configFields.label: Code 2 ID
configFields.description: A second barcode to carry -- a family member's parkrun ID, a membership number. Leave empty if you do not need it.
configFields.validationMessage: Up to 16 plain characters, exactly as printed.

configFields.label: Code 2 name
configFields.description: What the watch calls the second code. Optional.

configFields.label: Code 2 format
configFields.description: How to draw the second code. Code128 is the ordinary barcode; QRCode only works where a phone camera does the scanning.
